integrity: Finite-state proof and a standalone exact-rational checker support the mathematical statement. No independent audit, experimental validation, or priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Mean time to regional extinction only, not full survival distributions or finite-time probabilities.
No more than two patches; no non-Markovian rates or incomplete catastrophes.
Analytical formulas do not constitute empirical validation.
Full text of two historical adjacent papers was not obtained, so equivalent earlier coverage remains possible.
scientific_scope: Continuous-time occupancy Markov chain with two patches; strictly positive local extinction and recolonization rates; an independent region-wide extinction clock of rate r>=0; both patches occupied initially; comparison of designs with matched positive rate sums.
title: A one-crossing law for catastrophe-sensitive persistence rankings of two-patch metapopulations
